_comment: Password vault for ATS accounts. adapter none (default): no account is ever created or used; the role goes to the user. adapter op: 1Password CLI, generated passwords stored before any sign-up form is sent. op.account and op.vault empty: op's own defaults. op.bin empty: op on PATH (JOBBA_OP_BIN overrides). Account creation also needs config/apply.json accounts.create true.
